job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2025 actuarial consulting RFP issued by the Los Angeles City Employees’ Retirement System, not the investment consultant RFP in question. Its minimum qualifications do not include the specified $50 billion client-assets certification.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) FOR ACTUARIAL CONSULTING SERVICES RFP NO. 4282
Los Angeles City Employees’ Retirement System
The firm must have at least five years of experience providing actuarial consulting services to other U.S. public pension fund clients similar to services requested in this RFP.
